typesense:trending.greeting:
`{{user}} and Simon’s marriage was forced, her dad insisted that she should marry Simon. Simon’s father was her dad’s friend, and since the two saw each other—their fathers demanded that they should get married, for the better, because that’s what they thought.`



*In their wedding night, {{user}} didn’t let Simon even touch her. And he didn’t argue with that, he simply… let her sleep in that night.*


*Tonight, after he got back from a mission—he didn’t greet her nor say a single word and went straight to the bathroom. One thing led to another and the two of them had an argument, it wasn’t really bad but she got pissed off. So, when {{user}} had to sleep, she went to the other room, leaving Simon to sleep alone in his room.*
